description: Incident backtest dataset for the ossification factor. Categories: code-bug (exploitable flaw in onchain contract code - the risk class ossification measures), key-compromise, oracle-manipulation, economic-design, offchain-infra, governance-design. For code-bug incidents the exploited contract address is verified onchain: deployment timestamp via Etherscan contract creation, last pre-incident implementation change via EIP-1967 Upgraded logs (or documented basis where the architecture emits no standard event). Incident time is the exploit tx block timestamp where a tx hash is recorded, else the documented UTC date.

incidents.name: Poly Network
incidents.notes: EthCrossChainManager: crafted cross-chain message called EthCrossChainData.putCurEpochConPubKeyBytes via hash-collided function selector, replacing the keepers. Bug present since deployment.

incidents.name: Cream Finance (AMP reentrancy)
incidents.notes: crAMP market: ERC777-style reentrancy through AMP token transfer hooks during borrow. Market listed ~2 months before.

incidents.name: Compound (Comptroller COMP distribution)
incidents.notes: Unitroller: Proposal 062 (executed 2021-09-29) shipped a Comptroller implementation with a broken COMP distribution comparison; drained the next day. Age measured via Unitroller NewImplementation events.

incidents.name: Cream Finance (yUSD oracle)
incidents.notes: Flash-loan inflation of yUSD pricePerShare used by Cream's oracle. Not a code defect in the exploited contract's logic.

incidents.name: BadgerDAO
incidents.notes: Malicious script injected via compromised Cloudflare API key on the frontend harvested unlimited approvals. Contracts behaved as designed.

incidents.name: Multichain (AnyswapV4 permit)
incidents.notes: AnyswapV4Router: anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit did not validate the token, letting attackers pull WETH from accounts with stale approvals (WETH has no permit; fallback executed).

incidents.name: Qubit Finance (QBridge)
incidents.notes: Ethereum-side QBridge: deposit path allowed a 0-value deposit (safeTransferFrom on address(0) token) to emit a Deposit event minting unbacked qXETH collateral on BSC. Sources: halborn analysis; flaw located in QBridgeHandler on Ethereum.

incidents.name: Ronin Bridge
incidents.notes: 5 of 9 validator keys compromised (Sky Mavis nodes + Axie DAO RPC). No contract defect.

incidents.name: Beanstalk
incidents.notes: Flash-loaned governance stake passed and instantly executed a malicious BIP via emergencyCommit. Design flaw in governance parameters rather than an implementation bug; excluded from code-age stats, counted in scope stats.

incidents.name: Rari Fuse (Pool reentrancy)
incidents.notes: Fuse pool cEther (fToken) exitMarket/borrow cross-function reentrancy via .call value transfer before state update.

incidents.name: Harmony Horizon Bridge
incidents.notes: 2-of-5 multisig keys compromised. No contract defect.

incidents.name: Nomad Bridge
incidents.notes: Replica proxy: an upgrade + re-initialization on 2022-06-21 set committedRoot to 0x00, making every unproven message 'proven'. Beacon-proxy architecture emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event on the proxy; last-change date from the documented upgrade transaction (41 days before exploit).

incidents.name: Wintermute
incidents.notes: Profanity vanity-address private key brute-forced. No contract defect.

incidents.name: Transit Swap
incidents.notes: Router with arbitrary-call: attacker-controlled call target/data drained user approvals.

incidents.name: BNB Bridge (BSC Token Hub)
incidents.notes: Forged IAVL merkle proof accepted by the precompile-based cross-chain verification. Code defect, but in chain-level precompile code; no measurable EVM contract age - excluded from age stats.

incidents.name: Mango Markets
incidents.notes: MNGO perp price manipulation then borrowing against inflated collateral. Economic design, non-EVM; scope stats only.

incidents.name: Team Finance
incidents.notes: LockToken proxy: migrate() to Uniswap v3 (added in a recent upgrade) had insufficient validation of lock ownership/params. Age measured via Upgraded events on the proxy.

incidents.name: Ankr (aBNBc)
incidents.notes: Compromised deployer key upgraded the aBNBc token to a version with unrestricted mint. Key compromise (the code change itself was the attack).

incidents.name: Rubic
incidents.notes: RubicProxy: USDC was whitelisted as a routable 'router' (availableRouters setup tx 0x30679e7b at block 15414652, timestamp verified onchain), enabling arbitrary transferFrom of user approvals. knownLastChange = the whitelisting config change, per neptunemutual/solidityscan analyses.

incidents.name: dForce (curve oracle reentrancy)
incidents.notes: Read-only reentrancy against Curve pool virtual price used as oracle. Scope stats only.

incidents.name: Platypus Finance
incidents.notes: MasterPlatypusV4: emergencyWithdraw did not check outstanding USP debt, releasing collateral while keeping the borrowed USP. V4 deployed shortly before the exploit.

incidents.name: Euler Finance
incidents.notes: Euler main proxy: donateToReserves (added by eIP-14, activated 2022-07-28) skipped the liquidity check, enabling self-liquidation at a discount. Euler's module installer emits no EIP-1967 event; last-change date from the documented eIP-14 activation (~7.5 months before exploit).

incidents.name: Yearn (yUSDT misconfiguration)
incidents.notes: Legacy iearn yUSDT (deployed Feb 2020) was misconfigured to use the Fulcrum iUSDC pool instead of iUSDT since deployment; exploited >3 years later. Deliberately included as an aged-code counterexample.

incidents.name: Hundred Finance
incidents.notes: hWBTC market on Optimism (per Hundred's protocol docs): Compound-v2 fork empty-market exchange-rate inflation via direct donation, then rounding-truncated redeem.

incidents.name: Level Finance
incidents.notes: LevelReferralControllerV2: claimMultiple allowed repeated claims for the same epoch after an upgrade ~2 weeks earlier.

incidents.name: Jimbos Protocol
incidents.notes: Missing slippage/price control in the protocol-owned-liquidity rebalance let flash-loan price shifts be arbitraged against the treasury. Scope stats only.

incidents.name: Multichain (MPC seizure)
incidents.notes: MPC keys under unilateral control of the (detained) CEO; escrows drained. No contract defect.

incidents.name: Rodeo Finance
incidents.notes: TWAP oracle manipulation on a thin pool. Scope stats only.

incidents.name: Curve (Vyper compiler reentrancy)
incidents.notes: CRV/ETH pool (immutable, deployed 2021): Vyper 0.2.15-0.3.0 malfunctioning reentrancy locks. Deliberately included as an aged-code counterexample - the defect lived in the compiler, dormant for ~2 years.

incidents.name: Exactly Protocol
incidents.notes: DebtManager periphery: untrusted market parameter passed attacker contract through the permit path, bypassing the market check and moving user positions. Sources: neptunemutual/halborn analyses.

incidents.name: Onyx Protocol
incidents.notes: Compound-v2 fork empty-market donation/rounding on the freshly listed oPEPE market.

incidents.name: KyberSwap Elastic
incidents.notes: Elastic pool on Ethereum (one of three verified 'Pool' contracts emitting in the exploit tx, extracted from the tx receipt onchain): tick-boundary double-liquidity accounting error in the immutable pool code. Cross-chain exploit; larger losses on Arbitrum/Optimism.

incidents.name: Orbit Chain
incidents.notes: 7-of-10 vault multisig keys compromised. No contract defect.

incidents.name: Radiant Capital (flashloan rounding)
incidents.notes: LendingPool proxy: the newly activated native USDC reserve was exploited ~6-9 seconds after activation (2024-01-02 18:53:29 UTC) via the known Aave-v2 fresh-market index rounding window. Extreme young-code case; last change = reserve activation (quillaudits analysis), not a proxy upgrade.

incidents.name: Gamma Strategies
incidents.notes: Hypervisor vault (gDAI-DAI, one of ~40 hit): deposit price-change threshold misconfiguration allowed LP share mispricing during manipulated pool state. Source: verichains analysis.

incidents.name: Socket (Bungee)
incidents.notes: SocketGateway: a swap route added 3 days earlier performed an unvalidated user-controlled call, draining approvals. Route addition is an addRoute call, not an Upgraded event; date from the documented route-addition tx.

incidents.name: Abracadabra (CauldronV4)
incidents.notes: CauldronV4 (yvcrvSTETH): rounding drift in userBorrowPart accounting exploited to zero out borrow shares.

incidents.name: Seneca Protocol
incidents.notes: Chamber contract exposed an external performOperations with arbitrary call, draining user approvals.

incidents.name: Prisma Finance
incidents.notes: MigrateTroveZap: onFlashLoan did not validate initiator/params, letting anyone migrate (and re-open with attacker params) other users' troves.

incidents.name: Sonne Finance
incidents.notes: Compound-v2 fork empty-market donation attack on the soVELO market, executed in the window between market creation (timelocked proposal execution) and collateral-factor guard.

incidents.name: Velocore
incidents.notes: Balancer-style volatile CPMM pool fee computation flaw. L2 incident (Linea halted its sequencer in response). Excluded from age stats: the pool addresses quoted in public analyses turned out to be attacker-deployed contracts (verified onchain via creation lookups - creators include the attacker EOA), and the victim pool address could not be pinned with confidence.

incidents.name: UwU Lend
incidents.notes: sUSDE price oracle read manipulable curve pool spot mid-attack. Scope stats only.

incidents.name: Dough Finance
incidents.notes: ConnectorDeleverageParaswap: unvalidated flash-loan calldata executed arbitrary calls with user approvals. Source: certik analysis.

incidents.name: LI.FI
incidents.notes: LiFiDiamond: GasZipFacet added 5 days earlier performed an unvalidated depositToGasZipERC20 call (arbitrary call), draining approvals. Facet addition is a DiamondCut, not an Upgraded event; date from the documented facet-addition tx.

incidents.name: Penpie
incidents.notes: PendleStaking: reentrancy in batchHarvestMarketRewards with attacker-registered fake market inflating rewards.

incidents.name: Radiant Capital (multisig malware)
incidents.notes: 3 signer devices compromised with malware signing a malicious transferOwnership; contracts then upgraded by the attacker. Key compromise.

incidents.name: Delta Prime (November)
incidents.notes: Unvalidated claim proofs in reward claiming. Address not pinned; scope stats only.

incidents.name: zkLend
incidents.notes: Starknet money market: empty-market donation + rounding on the market contract (same class as Compound-v2 fork attacks). Non-EVM tooling; documented basis, scope stats + qualitative age note only.

incidents.name: Bybit
incidents.notes: Safe{Wallet} frontend supply-chain compromise served a masked delegatecall to the signers of the cold wallet. Contracts behaved as designed.

incidents.name: GMX v1
incidents.notes: GMX v1 Vault (deployed 2021): cross-contract reentrancy let short-position accounting inflate GLP price before redemption. Aged-code counterexample - v1 code was ~4 years old.

incidents.name: Cetus
incidents.notes: CLMM overflow check flaw in liquidity math (checked_shlw). Non-EVM; scope stats only.
